title: US Spot BTC ETFs Bleed $60.4M as Altcoin Capital Flows Increase
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs logged a net outflow of $60.48 million on Monday, while Ethereum and altcoin funds saw net inflows. The post US Spot BTC ETFs Bleed $60.4M as Altcoin Capital Flows Increase appeared first on Cryptonews .
